_meta.description: EVE Online security status mechanics: thresholds, faction police, clone soldier tags, and sec loss values
_meta.notes: Security status ranges from -10.0 to +5.0. Negative values restrict empire access progressively.

empire_access_thresholds.description: Minimum sec status for unrestricted access to each system security band. Below threshold: faction police engage. Two tiers below: station restrictions apply.

legend.faction_police: Sec status between faction_police_at and station_restricted_at

faction_police.description: Faction police response characteristics by system security

clone_soldier_tags.description: Tags turned in at CONCORD stations to raise security status
clone_soldier_tags.notes: Lower-tier tags are often cheaper per sec-point than higher-tier ones. Always check current market prices.

tag_farming.description: Clone soldier spawn locations in low-sec asteroid belts

sec_loss.description: Security status penalties for criminal actions

ratting_recovery.description: Killing NPCs in null-sec raises sec status slowly
ratting_recovery.notes: Very slow process. Tags are faster if you need empire access.
